name: erpnext-operations
description: Manage ERPNext Operations through authenticated CLI tools with built-in Codex browser login/key acquisition and browser fallback for unsupported client actions.

interface.longDescription: Default to authenticated CLI/client operations for organization administration, finance, sales, buying/stock, manufacturing, people/projects/support, content, and analytics. Use the built-in browser to select the project account and obtain missing login/keys securely, verify CLI identity and target, and fall back to browser operations only when the authenticated client lacks the requested capability.
defaultPrompt: Verify my ERPNext Operations CLI authentication for this project and use browser-assisted setup if missing.
Inspect my ERPNext Operations resources with the authenticated client.
Perform this ERPNext Operations operation through CLI, using browser only if unsupported.
